mapper.select: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_kcal * md.md_portion), 0) as total_kcal, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_carbs * md.md_portion), 0) as total_carbs, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_protein * md.md_portion), 0) as total_protein, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_fat * md.md_portion), 0) as total_fat, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_natrium * md.md_portion), 0) as total_sodium FROM meal_log ml JOIN meal_detail md ON ml.mk_num = md.mk_num JOIN food f ON md.fo_num = f.fo_num WHERE ml.user_num = #{userNum} AND DATE(ml.mk_created_at) = #{date}
SELECT DISTINCT DATE(mk_created_at) FROM meal_log WHERE user_num = #{userNum} ORDER BY DATE(mk_created_at) DESC

SELECT DATE(ml.mk_created_at) as log_date, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_kcal * md.md_portion), 0) as total_kcal, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_carbs * md.md_portion), 0) as total_carbs, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_protein * md.md_portion), 0) as total_protein, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_fat * md.md_portion), 0) as total_fat, COALESCE(SUM(f.fo_natrium * md.md_portion), 0) as total_sodium FROM meal_log ml JOIN meal_detail md ON ml.mk_num = md.mk_num JOIN food f ON md.fo_num = f.fo_num WHERE ml.user_num = #{userNum} AND DATE(ml.mk_created_at) BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE(ml.mk_created_at) ORDER BY log_date ASC
SELECT CASE up_model WHEN '1' THEN '다이어트' WHEN '2' THEN '건강유지' WHEN '3' THEN '근육증가' WHEN '4' THEN '저탄고지' ELSE '건강유지' END FROM user_privacy WHERE user_num = #{userNum}
